items.quote: of each shall there be a like weight
items.claim: Each ingredient should be in equal weight proportion

items.quote: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy
items.claim: Perfume should be made using apothecary's technique of tempering

items.quote: And thou shalt beat some of it very small
items.claim: Part of the mixture should be beaten into fine particles
